title: Financial Instruments: Presentation
intro: IAS 32 يحدد: الأداة **التزام** ولا **حقوق ملكية**؟ حسب جوهر العقد مش شكله القانوني.
الأداة المركبة (زي السندات القابلة للتحويل) تتقسم: الالتزام أولاً بالقيمة الحالية، وحقوق الملكية هي **الباقي**.

tf.s: Mandatorily redeemable preference shares are financial liabilities.
tf.why: There is a contractual obligation to pay cash.

tf.s: A convertible bond is split into a liability component and an equity component.
The equity component of a compound instrument is measured first at fair value.
tf.why: The liability is measured first; equity is the residual.

tf.s: Treasury shares are deducted from equity; no gain or loss goes to profit or loss.
tf.why: Transactions in own shares are in equity.

tf.s: Dividends on shares classified as liabilities are presented as interest expense.
Financial assets and liabilities may be offset whenever they are with the same counterparty.
tf.why: Need a legally enforceable right and intention to settle net.

fill.s: In a compound instrument, the equity component is the ___ amount.
Mandatorily redeemable preference shares are financial ___.
Offsetting needs a legally enforceable ___ to set off.
